title: Death Stranding 2 joins PS Plus Extra/Deluxe on 17 Nov (PS Blog); India: Extra ₹979/month; DS2 ₹4,999, ₹3,099 in PS Store sale until 20 Nov
headline: Death Stranding 2 Joins PS Plus Extra on 17 Nov
caption:
Death Stranding 2: On the Beach joins the PlayStation Plus Game Catalogue on 17 November, Sony's PlayStation Blog said on Tuesday. The catalogue comes with the Extra and Deluxe tiers; Essential (₹649 a month in India) doesn't include it.

In India, PS Plus Extra costs ₹979 a month, ₹2,599 for three months or ₹8,709 a year, and Deluxe costs ₹1,109 a month. Buying the game outright costs ₹4,999 for the Standard Edition on PS Store India, or ₹3,099 in the store's current sale, which runs until 20 November.

Atomfall and Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake join on 17 November too. Sony gives US and UK dates for the rest: Hell Let Loose on 11 November; Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii, Trepang2, MotoGP 26 and Cricket 26 on 24 November. Deluxe adds Soul Reaver 2 and Freedom Wars Remastered. Sony says lineups can differ by region.

Do you buy big PS5 games at launch, or wait for them to reach PS Plus?

Sources: PlayStation Blog, PlayStation India, Push Square, Digit, Gizmochina
